name: recovery_no_silence_20261103
comment: ANCHOR: RECOVERY_NO_SILENCE_20261103 — a T1 recovery case is paged as P1 (through telegram_batch when present, direct otherwise) and the router can never classify a marked T1 recovery message P2_DASHBOARD_ONLY or P3_LOG_ONLY; the no-silence invariant is test-pinned.
The R8 regressions live here too: a global reclaim mutex must not abandon this case's settle (a bounded
wait, then the owner-check path), and a settle must be bound to the attempt that owns it rather than to
whichever token is newest when it happens to run.
